headlines.description: Steven Hauschka matched a franchise record with five field goals, Marshawn Lynch scored Seattle's only touchdown on a 1-yard plunge and the Seahawks forced three turnovers in a surprising 22-17 victory over the Baltimore Ravens on Sunday.
